title: Matrix Perturbation Theory in the Tangent Space of Isospectral Matrices
summary: Eigenvalue and eigenvector perturbation theory is a fundamental topic in several disciplines, including numerical linear algebra, quantum physics, and related fields. The central problem is to understand how the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix $A \in \mathbb{C}^{n \times n}$ change under the addition of a perturbation matrix $E \in \mathbb{C}^{n \times n}$. Much of the existing literature focuses on structured perturbations. For example, in [C.-K. Li and R.-C.
